>>> s = sched.scheduler(time.time, time.sleep)
>>> def print_time(a='default'):
...     print("From print_time", time.time(), a)
...
>>> def print_some_times():

...     s.enter(10, 1, print_time)
...     s.enter(5, 2, print_time, argument=('positional',))
